prompt:
The pie chart below shows the main source of news for adults in one country in 2024, and the bar chart shows how long four age groups spent following the news each day.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visuals.title: Main source of news for adults, 2024
visuals.alt: Pie chart showing adults' main source of news in 2024, in percentages.

visuals.title: Time spent following the news each day by age group, 2024
visuals.alt: Bar chart showing the average number of minutes per day each of four age groups spent following the news.

key_points: News websites and apps are the most common main source (31%), with television close behind at 27%; the gap between them is only 4 points.
Non-screen and print sources stay small: radio 12%, printed newspapers 8% — newspapers are the smallest slice, at less than a quarter of news websites.
Taken together, the two internet-based sources (news websites 31% + social media 22% = 53%) cover more than half of adults.
Time spent following the news rises steadily with age: from 24 minutes to 62 minutes, meaning the oldest group spends roughly two and a half times as long as the youngest.
The increase accelerates at each step: 9 minutes are added from 18-29 to 30-44, then 12 minutes, then 17 minutes.
The two visuals measure different things — one shows which source is used (%), the other shows daily time (minutes); the pie chart is not broken down by age group.
common_mistakes: Describing only one of the two visuals — the task covers both.
Mixing up percentages and minutes ('31% of people watched the news for 24 minutes')
Linking the pie chart's distribution to age groups ('young people mostly use social media') — the chart makes no such distinction.
Failing to notice that the increase across the bars accelerates, and giving only the highest and lowest bars.
Inventing reasons or making predictions about the future ('newspapers will disappear within ten years')
topic: news sources and daily news consumption
